reason: The pet and streaks honestly sound fun, and I'd probably play with the free demo for a week. But my broker already gives me AI agents for free, and I'm not moving my real money to some future broker partner to pay a monthly fee they haven't even named yet.
objection: Why would I pay every month and move my account for an agent when my current broker already has one for free? A cute pet doesn't make that worth it.
would_change_my_mind: If it connected to the brokerage account I already have so I didn't have to move money, and the price came in around what Robinhood Gold costs.
